info.title: Restaurant OS API
info.description: Multi-tenant SaaS restaurant platform — backend API.

device-token.description: Companion device token (NOT a user JWT) for missed-call ingestion.

allBranches.description: Whether the caller has the all-branch capability (the Owner role): access to every active branch without an explicit membership. False for branch-explicit users, including restaurant-wide roles like Manager.

roleId.description: Role id (must belong to the same organization).

branchId.description: Optional branch scope within the restaurant.

roleId.description: Reassign to a role in the same organization.

restaurantId.description: Change restaurant scope (must belong to the org).

permissions.description: Permission keys; validated against the catalog.
Replaces the full permission set; validated against the catalog.

branchId.description: Branch the role applies at (must be in the user's restaurant).

roleId.description: Role granted at that branch (an org role's id).

allowManualTableStatus.description: Manual table status changes allowed (vs flow-driven).

enableCustomerOrdering.description: Allow customers to submit dine-in order requests (needs enableQrMenu).

isDefault.description: Whether this is the restaurant default branch.

branchId.description: The active branch (from the X-Branch-Id header).

allBranches.description: Whether the caller has the all-branch capability (the Owner role) — access to every active branch without an explicit membership.

categoryId.description: Category id (must belong to your restaurant).
Reassign to another category in your restaurant.

floorId.description: Floor id (must belong to your restaurant).
Move to another floor in your restaurant.

tableId.description: Required for DINE_IN on a table.

value.description: PERCENT -> basis points; FIXED -> minor units.

approvedByUserId.description: Approver user id (required if approvals are enforced).
Approver user id (required if approvals are enforced).

amount.description: Amount applied to the bill (minor units).

tenderedAmount.description: Cash tendered (>= amount); used only to compute change.

parts.description: Number of even shares to split the total into.

remainder.description: Remainder distributed to the first shares.

itemIds.description: Item ids to move to a new linked check.

elapsedSeconds.description: Seconds since the item was sent to the kitchen.

reservedAt.description: Requested date+time (ISO 8601, must be in the future).

token.description: Plaintext device token — shown once; store it now.

tableId.description: Assign a table (plan only; no live hold).

restaurantSlug.description: Restaurant storefront slug the token resolved to.

branchSlug.description: Branch slug the scanned table belongs to.

slug.description: Url-safe per-restaurant slug used in public routes.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the restaurant default branch.

lastUnitCostMicro.description: Last unit cost at MICRO precision (cost-per-base-unit x 1e6), as a string.

factor.description: Integer conversion factor to the base unit (e.g. kg→1000).

baseUnit.description: Canonical integer base unit for all stored quantities.

derivedUnitCost.description: Derived per-base-unit cost (decimal; not stored rounded).

remainingValuationAmount.description: Costed value of the remaining quantity (minor units).

costAmount.description: Signed costed value in minor units.

rawSources.description: RAW/PROCESSED items that are inputs to a process producing this item.

processedOutputs.description: PROCESSED items produced by a process that takes this item as input.

itemId.description: Inventory item id (must belong to your restaurant).

unit.description: Entered unit: the item base unit or a defined alternate unit name.

qty.description: Quantity in the entered unit (positive integer).

lineTotalCostAmount.description: Total amount paid for this line, in integer minor units.

expiryDate.description: ISO date; only allowed when the item has trackExpiry enabled.

receivedAt.description: ISO datetime the goods were received. Defaults to now.

itemId.description: Inventory item id (must belong to your restaurant).

unit.description: Entered unit: the item base unit or a defined alternate unit name.

qty.description: Quantity in the entered unit (positive integer).

costAmount.description: Signed costed value in minor units.

wentNegative.description: True if an OUT adjustment drove on-hand negative.

uncosted.description: True if the change could not be costed (no known unit cost).

onHandBase.description: On-hand quantity in base units (sum of the ledger; may be negative).

valuationAmount.description: Valuation of OPEN layers in integer minor units.

itemId.description: Inventory item id (RAW or PROCESSED) to consume.

baseQty.description: Quantity consumed per 1× batch, in the item base unit.

itemId.description: Output item id (MUST be kind PROCESSED).

baseQty.description: Quantity produced per 1× batch, in the item base unit.

isPrimary.description: Marks the output that absorbs cost when no shares are set.

processingCostAmount.description: Per-run processing cost in minor units.

itemId.description: Output item id this expiry applies to.

expiryDate.description: ISO date; applied only if the output item has trackExpiry.

multiplier.description: Scales every input and output baseQty.

runAt.description: ISO datetime of the run. Defaults to now.

inputCostAmount.description: Sum of consumed input costs (minor units).
Sum of consumed input costs (minor units).

estimatedUnitCostAmount.description: Forward-looking estimated unit cost (minor units). Informational.

baseQty.description: Quantity consumed per 1 unit of the dish, in the item base unit.

modifierOptionId.description: Modifier option id that triggers this extra usage.

itemId.description: Inventory item consumed when the option is selected.

baseQty.description: Extra quantity per 1 unit of the dish, in the item base unit.

menuItemId.description: Menu item this recipe belongs to (one recipe per menu item).

unit.description: ITEM: entered unit (base or alternate unit name).

qty.description: ITEM: quantity in the entered unit.

menuItemId.description: DISH: menu item id whose recipe is exploded.

occurredAt.description: ISO datetime the loss occurred. Defaults to now.

costAmount.description: Actual FIFO cost consumed for this line (minor units).

bundle.description: The catalog bundle object (as produced by /export). Validated by the engine.

conflictStrategy.description: On an existing key: SKIP leaves it untouched; OVERWRITE updates it to match.

include.description: Sections to include: menu, inventory, recipes, processes. Default: all.

priceAmount.description: Price in integer minor units (e.g. cents).

password.description: Optional. If omitted, a strong password is generated and returned once.

ownerPassword.description: Returned ONCE. Generated if no password was supplied.

paymentsEnabled.description: No payment processing yet — billing/payments integration pending.

token.description: Plaintext node token — shown once; store it now.
